killer.title: Torn correspondence
killer.content: A letter fragment mentions the victim and an appointment that was not meant to be discussed. The writer's name is missing.

killer.title: Duplicate photograph
killer.content: A duplicate photograph of the victim has a second figure cut from its edge.

killer.title: Unsent apology
killer.content: A draft apology asks that a private meeting not be repeated. The salutation has been removed.

killer.title: Dance hall receipt
killer.content: A receipt for two entries at a dance hall is dated the evening before the victim's death.

killer.title: Marked appointment book
killer.content: A name is written beside the victim's initials and then scratched out hard enough to tear the paper.

killer.title: Unclaimed scarf
killer.content: A scarf unfamiliar to the household is folded inside a drawer with no note or label.

killer.title: Photostat of a letter
killer.content: A copied letter asks the victim to stop seeing someone. The signature is cut off in the copy.

killer.title: Two cinema stubs
killer.content: Two adjacent cinema stubs are kept with a receipt for a different date. The names are not recorded.

victim.title: Private appointment note
victim.content: A note records an appointment the victim had tried to keep private. The other person's name has been torn away.

victim.title: Unmailed photograph
victim.content: A photograph of two people has been placed face down in an envelope. No message is enclosed.

victim.title: Unsigned warning
victim.content: A handwritten warning asks the victim to leave a relationship alone. The writer gives no reason.

victim.title: Duplicate key tag
victim.content: A spare key tag carries a room number that has been crossed out and rewritten.

victim.title: Torn dance card
victim.content: A dance card has one partner's name removed, leaving only the first initial.

victim.title: Unsent letter
victim.content: A letter asks for an explanation about a meeting at the riverfront. The final paragraph is missing.

victim.title: Theatre ticket pair
victim.content: Two seats were booked together for a performance. Only one ticket stub remains.

victim.title: Calling card
victim.content: A visiting card has a telephone number written on its reverse and no name on the front.

colleague.title: Office concert ticket
colleague.content: A company hall ticket for 11 October has two seats marked in pencil, one beside the other.

colleague.title: Shared lunch chit
colleague.content: Two lunch portions were charged to the same floor account on 8 October; the counter stamp reads 12:15.

colleague.title: Returned key receipt
colleague.content: The building porter recorded a duplicate office key returned at 19:05 on 10 October. The witness line is blank.

colleague.title: Dance card
colleague.content: A company social dance card lists the same partner for the final two sets, dated 12 October.

associate.title: Tea room reservation
associate.content: A reservation for two at the Lantern Tea Room is dated 7 October, 18:30; the second name is omitted.

associate.title: Postcard draft
associate.content: A postcard addressed only 'Dear M.' mentions the river promenade on Sunday, 11 October.

associate.title: Photographer's claim ticket
associate.content: A portrait claim ticket is numbered 184 and dated 13 October. The collection box is unchecked.

associate.title: Pressed flower envelope
associate.content: A pressed violet is kept in an envelope marked 'Station garden, 6 October' in faded ink.
